name: L0014
label: L0014 (Internal)
summary: Authors TransLaTeX translation rule sets — the words, types, rules and test corpus that drive @graffiticode/translatex.
authoring_guide: L0014 is an internal language. A program declares a translation rule set and a corpus that validates it. Four statements, in any order: `words { ... }` maps a LaTeX token to its replacement; `types { ... }` names reusable pattern classes; `rules { ... }` maps a source pattern to its expansion; `tests [ ... ]` is a list of [source, expected] pairs run against the rule set the program builds. Compiling emits { options, tests } — `options` is the rule set a consumer hands to TransLaTeX.buildTranslator, and `tests` is each case scored 1 or -1. Backslashes must be doubled in string literals.

examples.prompt: A rule set that renders addition and multiplication with explicit spacing, with two tests.
examples.notes: rules maps a pattern to an expansion; %1 and %2 are the operands.
